description: Geometric constraints for GH components - preconditions and postconditions
note: component_guid values are for reference only and may be placeholder values. Constraint lookup uses component names (case-insensitive), not GUIDs.

preconditions.description: Loft requires at least 2 curves
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Add more curves to the Curves (C) input

preconditions.description: All curves should have consistent direction for clean loft
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Flip Curve component to align curve directions

preconditions.description: Curves should be ordered from start to end of loft
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Sort List or manually reorder curve inputs

postconditions.description: Loft should produce a surface or brep

preconditions.description: First input (A) must be a closed solid brep
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Cap Holes component or ensure brep is fully closed

preconditions.description: Second input (B) must be a closed solid brep
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Cap Holes component or ensure brep is fully closed

preconditions.description: Objects should intersect for meaningful boolean difference
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Verify object positions overlap in 3D space

postconditions.description: Result should be a valid closed solid

preconditions.description: First input must be a closed solid brep
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Cap Holes component or ensure brep is fully closed

preconditions.description: Second input must be a closed solid brep
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Cap Holes component or ensure brep is fully closed

postconditions.description: Result should be a valid closed solid

preconditions.description: First input must be a closed solid brep
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Cap Holes component or ensure brep is fully closed

preconditions.description: Second input must be a closed solid brep
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Cap Holes component or ensure brep is fully closed

preconditions.description: Objects must actually intersect for result to exist
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Move objects so they overlap in 3D space

postconditions.description: Intersection should produce geometry if objects overlap

preconditions.description: Rail curve is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a curve to the Rail (R) input

preconditions.description: Section curve(s) required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect section curve(s) to the Sections (S) input

preconditions.description: Section curves should be perpendicular to rail at connection point
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Orient section curves perpendicular to rail direction

preconditions.description: First rail curve is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a curve to Rail 1 (R1) input

preconditions.description: Second rail curve is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a curve to Rail 2 (R2) input

preconditions.description: Section curve(s) required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect section curve(s) to Sections (S) input

preconditions.description: Rails should have same direction and similar parameterization
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Flip Curve to align rail directions if needed

preconditions.description: Base geometry is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect curve or surface to Base (B) input

preconditions.description: Direction vector must be non-zero
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Unit Z * height or construct a proper direction vector

preconditions.description: For solid output, base curve should be closed
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Close the curve or use Cap Holes after extrusion

preconditions.description: Curve input is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a curve to the Curve (C) input

preconditions.description: Radius must be positive
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use absolute value or ensure radius > 0

preconditions.description: Radius should be smaller than minimum curve radius to avoid self-intersection
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Reduce pipe radius or use a smoother curve

postconditions.description: Pipe should be a valid closed brep

preconditions.description: Profile curve is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a curve to the Curve (C) input

preconditions.description: Axis must be properly defined (line or two points)
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Define axis using a Line or Axis input

preconditions.description: Profile curve should not cross the revolution axis
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Move profile curve to one side of the axis

postconditions.description: Revolve should produce a surface or brep

preconditions.description: First curve (A) is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a curve to the A input

preconditions.description: Second curve (B) is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a curve to the B input

preconditions.description: Curves should have same direction for clean ruled surface
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Use Flip Curve to align curve directions

preconditions.description: Brep input is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a brep to the Brep (B) input

preconditions.description: Brep should have planar holes that can be capped
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Only planar naked edges can be capped; non-planar holes remain open

postconditions.description: Output should be a closed solid if all holes were planar

preconditions.description: Surface input is required
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Connect a surface to the Surface (S) input

preconditions.description: Offset distance should be less than minimum surface radius
preconditions.fix_suggestion: Reduce offset distance to avoid self-intersection
